svg.text: How the two parts fit together
Front end: VGG-16 with its last two pooling steps removed
shrinks the image to a 64 × 64 grid of positions, with one score map per category
category score maps: how much each position looks like each category
orange: a patch of road that scores more like sidewalk
Context module: 7 dilated 3 × 3 layers, then a 1 × 1 layer
dilations 1, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 1; same size in and out: 64 × 64, one map per category
refined score maps: the patch now scores as road
label at each position: the highest-scoring category
Illustration, not the paper's data. Grids are drawn 16 × 11 for space; the real maps are 64 × 64.
